title: Austin Leaders Address Abortion Rights
summary:
*   Austin city officials will attend a press conference focusing on abortion access.
*   A significant number of city leaders are expected to be present at the event.
*   It is noted that no formal policy decisions or official actions will be taken.
transcript:
THE AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL WILL MEET ON 
THURSDAY, JULY 21, 2022, AT 12:00 PM, AT AUSTIN 
CITY HALL, 301 W. SECOND STREET, AUSTIN, TX 
78701 
 
 
Press Conference  
Attend a Press Conference regarding abortion access. 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
